item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Walmart Hazmat incident in Brooksville prompts evacuation: HCFR

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Qantas completes test flight ahead of record-breaking 22-hour Sydney-London route
item.description: Qantas completed a successful test flight ahead of plans to launch 22-hour nonstop flights between Sydney and London in 2027.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Prague zoo keeps polar bears cool with ice cubes as heatwave hits
item.description: Keepers at Prague Zoo used tons of ice on Thursday to give its animals some much-needed relief as yet another heat wave hit Europe.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Feeding Tampa Bay school pantries are feeding minds, improving grades in Hillsborough County
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 partners with Feeding Bay and Achieva Credit Union for our Pack the Pantries and more initiative. The goal is to bring food and supplies directly to schools where students are at risk of food insecurity.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump may pull, later renominate Todd Blanche for AG amid GOP opposition
item.description: President Donald Trump said Thursday he may temporarily withdraw Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general after two Republican senators have opposed advancing it.

item.description: UEFA member federations agreed Thursday to boycott all FIFA competitions in protest at Gianni Infantino's plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private equity investors.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] The Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady, some economists predict potential rate hike soon
item.description: The Federal Reserve has decided to hold interest rates steady in a 9-3 vote. Some economists are predicting a potential rate hike soon.
